events.title: Sunday Night Comedy
events.description: Fill your night with laughter at Atrium Bar’s Comedy Club, presented by Based Comedy and hosted by local radio personality Danny Lakey! Enjoy a new line up of local and national comedians every week, and settle into one of our comfy bean bags for a night full of fun and food. Reserve space for your group at the link.

events.title: Friday Night Comedy
events.description: Every Friday night we are taking over upstairs at Madocke with a line up of the best comedians from around Australia and internationally at one of the Gold Coast's newest and coolest little breweries. Belgian beers, big laughs and the perfect way to knock off for the week with a laugh. Every week from 7pm at Madocke Beer Brewing Company.

events.title: Saturday Showcase Show
events.description: Every Saturday night, Based Comedy presents Comedy Underground in The Basement. It's a weekly showcase of hand-picked talent from all over the Australia and around the world. Big name acts, up-and-coming crushers and the wild, subversive and unique voices making waves in live comedy. Saturday nights in The Basement are packed with 90 minutes of side splitting laughs, and fresh new line ups every week. Comedy Underground is the Gold Coast's home of the very best live comedy. Comedy Underground is presented by Based Comedy and HOTA, Home of the Arts.

events.title: Help Me Please
events.description: You probably already know me from reading the news. In 2018, I dressed up as a sewing needle and hid inside a strawberry. There should be a French word for the moment you realize a bald dude actually has a ponytail. I'm so used to failure that success represents an existential threat. "His mind works like no other” ★★★★★ – Chortle (UK) “The speed and frequency of his jokes is dizzying… Buckle up.” ★★★★ – The Guardian "Book yesterday” ★★★★ – The Age New Faces of Comedy, Just For Laughs Montreal, 2025 Winner: Best of the Fest, Sydney Comedy Festival, 2025 Winner: Director’s Choice Award, Melbourne International Comedy Festival, 2025 alist.com.au
